assert.//: Asserts all 175 audits via the preset. The point is the 41 that pass on every page today — ARIA correctness, form labels, table headers, list structure, doctype, charset — which cost nothing to lock in and catch the regression a weighted category score would otherwise absorb. Every exception below was measured failing across 72 desktop and mobile reports on 2 August 2026; none is guessed. Groups: (a) fixable and being fixed, held at warn — errors-in-console, color-contrast, td-has-header, heading-order, aria-allowed-role; (b) uses-long-cache-ttl and cache-insight, which GitHub Pages controls and no change to this repo can affect; (c) timing metrics, whose real signal is the category score rather than the individual audit; (d) known work — oversized heroes, the GoDaddy bundles, the homepage's inline CSS — tracked as tasks rather than as a daily red run. Comment keys must not appear inside 'assertions': LHCI reads every key there as an audit id and fails an auditRan check against it.
